english_problem: Let O and H be the circumcenter and orthocenter of an acute scalene triangle ABC, with OH=7. At A, let Ka and La be where the internal and external angle bisectors meet line BC, respectively, and let Ma be the midpoint of BC. Let Pa be the intersection other than A of circle AKaLa with line AMa. Define Pb and Pc cyclically at B and C. Let Z be the center of circle PaPbPc. Find OZ. Assume all circles and intersections are nondegenerate.
